Specification: This module defines a collection of helper operators for finite sets, extending standard set functionality with folds, reductions, aggregation, subset selection, extrema, combinatorial choice construction, and unique selection. It is a library-style module rather than a transition-system specification: it introduces no variables, no actions, and no temporal behavior, and its operators are purely mathematical expressions over sets, functions, and integers. The design emphasizes convenience and backward compatibility, for example by providing aliases like ReduceSet and FlattenSet, while comments also note that some operators are intended to be overridden by more efficient implementations that avoid unnecessary enumeration.
ChoiceExpr: CHOOSE x \in S : \A y \in S : x >= y
CHOOSE x \in S : \A y \in S : x =< y
CHOOSE x \in S : P(x) /\ \A y \in S : P(y) => y = x
